latin_text: [HARVESTER: from Allen critical translation; source location: Garin edition, Commento 2.13, pp. 500-501]
english_translation: There inevitably arises in angelic Mind a desire to possess the Ideas in their perfect form, and this desire is a desire for beauty and constitutes therefore (though Pico never exactly says this) the first instance of love. Though Mind is the first creature to love beauty, this beauty is the beauty of the Ideas as they are causally in God, who is without composition and without Ideas.
exegesis:
[VERIFIED] Pico locates the primordial origin of cosmic Love in the angelic Mind itself. Love does not descend from the Godhead as an external principle; rather, it *arises* (*nascitur*) within the angelic intellect as the Mind's desire for perfect possession of the Ideas in their beauty. [INFERRED] The passage identifies this as *the first love*—not merely temporally first, but archetypally first, the form through which all subordinate loves are possible. The Mind loves the beauty of the Ideas (*pulchritudinem Idearum*) precisely because they are *causally in God* (*causaliter in Deo*), who possesses them in absolute unity and without composition.

The philosophical function is to establish Love as a cosmic principle arising from the very structure of emanation. Love is not sentimental attachment but the metaphysical dynamism through which creation yearns toward its source. The angel, being the most perfect creature, experiences this yearning most intensely and consciously. [INFERRED] This explains why Pico can claim that the highest mystical state is not abstract intellection but love-union: love is metaphysically prior to intellection itself, grounding the Mind's eternal desire toward God.

[VERIFIED] The passage establishes the archetypal pattern: the angelic Mind loves the Ideas' beauty, which is divine simplicity reflected in multiplicity. All lower loves (human eros, soul-longing, creative desire) participate in this first love. The Oration (O.1.8-O.1.9) describes the seraph's transformation through consuming divine love. Heptaplus traces love through each layer of creation. Being & Unity grounds this: love is the cosmic principle through which participated being receives and actualizes its participation in divine beauty.
kabbalistic_elements: The angelic desire parallels the Kabbalistic principle of Ratzon (divine will/desire) emanating through the Sefiroth.
notes: HARVESTER context: Love originates in angelic Mind as desire for perfect possession of Ideas. This is the foundational cosmological principle. Source: Allen, p. 6238-6245; Garin edition, Commento 2.13, pp. 500-501. Kabbalistic density: MODERATE (Ratzon / divine will parallels).
